neutral_facts.value: The prosecution alleged that on 18.01.2007, at about 8:30 p.m., the accused formed an unlawful assembly armed with hunting sickles and surrounded a vehicle in which the deceased and others were traveling. The accused forcibly opened the vehicle, dragged out the deceased, and hacked him with hunting sickles, causing his death. The driver and another passenger sustained injuries. The police registered a case after a delay of seven hours, but the FIR was sent to the magistrate within 24 hours. The prosecution relied on eyewitnesses and injured witnesses to establish the accused's involvement in the incident.
